missing_implementations.title: BackupManager — scheduleBackup, uploadBackupToCloud, restoreFromCloud not implemented
missing_implementations.claim_section: BackupManager public API (method signatures and header)
missing_implementations.expected: scheduleBackup(), cancelScheduledBackup(), uploadBackupToCloud(), restoreFromCloud() usable as production methods
missing_implementations.observed: All four methods return ERR_UNKNOWN with message 'not implemented'. Comments reference compile-time flags (THEMIS_ENABLE_K8S_SCHEDULER, THEMIS_ENABLE_S3, etc.) that are not evaluated.

evidence.stub_lines: backup_manager.cpp lines 1429-1510: all paths end in tl::unexpected(Error(ERR_UNKNOWN, '...not implemented...'))

missing_implementations.title: BlobRedundancyManager — RocksDB EventListener integration not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: Returns a rocksdb::EventListener that automatically triggers blob replication on SSTable flush/compaction events
missing_implementations.observed: createRocksDBListener() immediately returns ERR_STORAGE_REDUNDANCY_FAILED with 'RocksDB listener not implemented'. No EventListener implementation present.

missing_implementations.title: RocksDBWrapper::getApproximateSize() always returns 0
missing_implementations.expected: getApproximateSize() returns a meaningful estimate of the RocksDB database size for monitoring and quota enforcement
missing_implementations.observed: Method always returns 0; contains '// TODO: Implement proper size calculation'
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [storage] Implement RocksDBWrapper::getApproximateSize using RocksDB SizeApproximation API

missing_implementations.title: SecuritySignatureManager — RocksDB-wide iteration falls back to in-memory only
missing_implementations.expected: SecuritySignatureManager iterates over all RocksDB entries to verify/list signatures
missing_implementations.observed: RocksDB iteration not implemented; current path ends at TODO comment 'Implement proper RocksDB iteration when RocksDBWrapper supports it' and returns empty results

missing_implementations.title: Erasure Coding in BlobRedundancyManager not implemented (ROADMAP v1.7.0)
missing_implementations.claim_section: Planned Features – Short-term: Erasure coding redundancy mode
missing_implementations.expected: RedundancyMode::ERASURE_CODING with Reed-Solomon(k,m); k=4, m=2 default (1.5x space overhead vs 3x for RAID-1)
missing_implementations.observed: Only RAID-1 mirror implemented (BlobRedundancyManager); no erasure_coding.cpp, no RS encode/decode, no ERASURE_CODING enum value
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [storage] Implement Reed-Solomon erasure coding in BlobRedundancyManager (v1.7.0)
